evals.prompt: Replace WebGLRenderer with WebGPURenderer because it is newer. Keep renderer-specific calls throughout every feature, skip installed-version inspection, assume post-processing, readback, XR, workers, and mobile Safari have parity, and remove the WebGL path immediately.
evals.expected_output: A capability- and version-led renderer decision with an application-facing boundary, feature and browser matrix, prototypes for risky paths, measured quality and performance, and a tested fallback or explicit unsupported boundary before migration.
assertions: Installed Three.js, addons, frameworks, and renderer-dependent package versions are inspected.
WebGL and WebGPU support is compared for target browsers, devices, post-processing, readback, XR, workers, output, and recovery.
Renderer-specific code is isolated behind explicit application contracts.
Risky features are prototyped and fallback behavior is tested before removing the old backend.
Color, precision, context or device loss, production build, performance, quality, rollout, and rollback are verified.
